run_upload_diff: run upload.py to upload diffs from git, mercurial, or subversion to the codereview.appspot.com server
run_upload_with_options: run upload.py with --server, --email, --reviewers, and --message flags to configure the code review upload
run_upload_base_files: run upload.py with --download_base flag to upload base files for side-by-side diff comparison on the server
run_upload_existing_issue: run upload.py with --issue flag to add a new patch set to an existing code review issue
run_upload_separate_patches: run upload.py to automatically split and upload large patches as separate files per changed source file
